results.name: CenterPoint Energy
results.key_finding: CenterPoint's own Form 8-K of 14 September 2026 confirms customer personal data was stolen; the five class actions filed 10-13 September are allegations, and the 7.49M-record figure is an unverified claimant number this assessment does not use.

results.name: Ukraine
results.key_finding: Attribution held: the 8 September Kyiv strike is Russian conduct and scores nothing against Ukraine. What it does show is a working alert-and-rescue chain alongside only one certified public modular shelter in Kyiv, with the shelter-construction law entering force the same day.

results.name: Bangladesh
results.key_finding: The 15 September ICT ruling moved four dimensions in opposite directions - EQU +0.2 and ACC +0.2 on a court-ordered transfer of half the convicted men's assets to victims' families, EMP -0.2 and BND -0.2 on in-absentia capital sentencing without counsel of choice - netting to an unchanged 35.0, the third consecutive measurement 0.2 points inside the filing threshold.

results.name: Alphabet/Google
results.key_finding: Mirrors the 2026-09-20 Anthropic screening exactly: a filed complaint is procedural and the challenged conduct is a safety commitment, so zero movement. The 17 September DeepMind Institute launch is recorded as a watch item, not banked, and the 40.0 band boundary is retained.

results.name: Iran
results.key_finding: The tier-4 UN fact-finding mission finding of 17 September corroborates each near-floor dimension specifically - killings in all 31 provinces, at least 221 children killed some aged two, 29 executions after expedited trials - upgrading the evidence behind 2.5 from NGO tallies to a UN mandate without moving the number. Floor designation withheld on the two-source rule.

results.name: Oakland
results.key_finding: Attribution resolved: one of the three indicted is a federal FAA inspector, not a city employee, and the conduct is two pilots' private credential fraud from July 2023 to March 2024. It scores as an unresolved supervision gap, not a departmental failure. The countervailing fact is first-ever compliance with all 51 federal consent-decree tasks.

results.name: Lightmatter
results.key_finding: First-ever baseline on the public record measured 31.3 against a byte-flat 2.5 seed vector, but the whole -6.2 delta is produced by a private company publishing no responsibility data. Proposal withheld under 3e-bis check 5 as an ai-labs cohort calibration question and referred for a de-seeding study.

results.name: Macy's
results.key_finding: A band crossing was measured and deliberately withheld: the published 41.3 was set by a documented 2026-04-22 baseline found on disk under the mangled slug macy-x27-s, the scanner recorded zero in-window evidence, and the entire gap is 0.15 raw points of re-interpretation - a false positive under 3e-bis checks 2 and 4.

results.name: Marsh & McLennan
results.key_finding: Highest-placed suspected seed vector in this cycle: 3.5 on seven of eight dimensions at rank 42 of 447, never assessed and never revised. An indicative first pass read 24.6 points lower but is not filed, because MSCI AA and Sustainalytics 19.5 contradict it and the 2023 ESG report was not read. Referred for a fortune-500 flat-vector de-seeding study.

results.name: Key Energy Services
results.key_finding: Not scoreable: the company filed a Form 15 on 14 December 2020 and has made no public SEC filings since, yet it is published in the Fortune 500 index at f500Rank 500. This is an entity-record defect of the same class as the open Halodi/1X duplicate and must be resolved before any score attached to it is corrected.
